0022600164.text: The Dallas Mavericks (4-2, on a three-game winning streak and 2-1 at home) host the Sacramento Kings (0-5, on a five-game losing streak) in the Mavericks' seventh game of the 2026-27 season, with Dallas sitting 3rd in the Southwest, 1.5 games back, and 7th in the West while Sacramento is 5th in the Pacific, 3.5 games back, and 15th in the West. Dallas will be without Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Santi Aldama (knee, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), while Sacramento will be missing Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Mavericks lost 1-2 to the Kings, including a 130-121 home loss in Dallas on February 26, 2026.
